323:t_10:53.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Then, may I ask you one thing?」

323:t_10:55.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Tell me about $$フィアナ$$.」

323:t_10:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「...Fine. Only as far as I know, though.」

324:t_000:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Good... All units have sortied.」

324:t_000:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「$$グルフェー$$ is full of $$マーティアル$$ believers. If we dawdle, this will turn into a mess.」

324:t_000:2.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Move out. We take that town before $$マーティアル$$ shows up.」

324:t_000:3.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Captain...! An $$ＡＴ$$ is coming from the town!」

324:t_000:4.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Tch... bodyguards the town hired!? ...How many are there!?」

324:t_001:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Not a bad finish. Thanks, $$ゴウト$$.)

324:t_001:2.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「C-could it be a scout?」

324:t_001:3.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「What scout would come out just so we can spot it!?」

324:t_001:4.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Then it's some kind of trap...」

324:t_001:5.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「I don't know...! But if it's a challenge to the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$, we'll take it on!」

324:t_002:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Captain! We've confirmed an $$ＡＴ$$ approaching us!」

324:t_002:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「His reinforcements have arrived!?」

324:t_003:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「$$エルドスピーネ$$! Has $$マーティアル$$ already arrived!?」

324:t_003:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「B-but... it looks like a single unit!」

324:t_004:0.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「Are you going to back up that $$スコープドッグ$$?」

324:t_004:1.en:
$$黒い稲妻旅団$$
「But they don't seem to be coordinating...」

324:t_004:2.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I need neither words nor heart... But I will keep pursuing $$キリコ$$...)

324:t_004:3.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(That is what I live for.)

324:t_005:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Careful, $$キリコ$$! Here they come!」

324:t_006:1.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「We have confirmed the Untouchable, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, and $$テイタニア$$.」

324:t_006:2.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Her title of Shield of Order has already been revoked. She, too, is a target for us to eliminate.」

324:t_006:3.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Just as the notice from HQ said. So the apostate $$テイタニア$$ was chasing the Untouchable after all.」

324:t_006:4.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「What shall we do about that group of black $$ＡＴ$$s?」

324:t_006:5.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Must be the bandits we got the petition about. We'll clear them out while we're at it.」

324:t_006:6.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Father... Are you still after $$キリコ$$...)

324:t_006:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$... They're targeting you, too.」

324:t_006:8.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I know. But I don't intend to trouble you.」

324:t_007:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Let's cover each other's blind spots.」

324:t_008:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Why...? In the end, I took $$フィアナ$$'s life.」

324:t_008:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「It's not your fault, or anyone's.」

324:t_008:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If you don't want to die, fight.」

324:t_008:5.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Those who defy $$マーティアル$$ have joined hands...!」

324:t_008:6.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Captain! A unit is approaching this area!」

324:t_008:7.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「This is... a mobile suit!」

324:t_009:0.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「$$ガンダム$$...! Heathens who defy our God!」

324:t_009:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that $$スコープドッグ$$ over there $$キリコ$$!?」

324:t_009:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We finally found some $c besides ourselves.」

324:t_009:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「Fighting in the middle of a battle, that's just like him.」

324:t_009:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But he's with a $$マーティアル$$ $$ＡＴ$$...」

324:t_009:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「This woman is not an enemy.」

324:t_009:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The circumstances are unclear, but if he says so, we will follow his word.」

324:t_009:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The targets to eliminate are that group of black $$ＡＴ$$s and $$マーティアル$$, then.」

324:t_009:10.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Both sides seem to be hostile to each other.」

324:t_009:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「A three-way bloodbath right off the bat, huh?」

324:t_009:12.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$キリコ$$ isn't the only one who fits that kind of situation, it seems.」

324:t_009:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「Looks like our opponents are some sort of bandits and a $$マーティアル$$ private army... Then no mercy is necessary.」

324:t_010:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Look! A $$サイデリアル$$ transport ship is coming!」

324:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「What were you thinking, $$キリコ$$! Sortieing on your own like that!」

324:t_011:1.en:
$n
「Wait, $$カレン$$! It looks like he isn't alone!」

324:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected the $$プリベンター$$ party to have joined up with you.」

324:t_011:3.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We came running after receiving your transmission, and it seems our timing was good.」

324:t_011:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This could be a coincidence caused by the $$異能生存体$$, too.」

324:t_011:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Knowing you lot, I figured you were safe.」
